alex_kaplan: Quick sync — I sketched a retention-policy matrix (enterprise tiers) + BYOK scoping we should align on before we freeze MVP for the Q3 compliance push. Pasting the draft below, please react with :eyes: and flag blockers.
maria_patel: paste it here please — legal will want to see retention + export + hold semantics.
alex_kaplan: ```
tier,default_retention,max_retention,byok_supported,export_api,legal_hold
startup,90d,2y,no,yes,yes
scale,1y,7y,yes (managed->escrow),yes,yes
enterprise,3y,10y,yes (customer-KMS),yes,yes
```
samir_gupta: couple of notes: 1) cost on 10y for enterprise is large — need cold archive pricing. 2) BYOK handshake for customer-KMS needs rotation + emergency-eviction plan.
devsec-bot: Policy check: SOC2 auditors expect retention justification. Long retention (>7y) will require retention policy docs, key custody proofs, and periodic access reviews.
jess_ops: For launch gating I propose minimal set:
- gating: export API + tenant-level retention toggle + BYOK handshake basic (store key-ref, do not accept raw keys)
- non-blocking but high priority: UI for retention, long-term archive pipeline, key-rotation runbook
- blockers: legal escrow contract, KMS attestation (HSM), backup/restore test covering retained data
maria_patel: Legal: we need a documented Data Retention Matrix (who-approved, purpose, deletion workflow) and a legal-hold override endpoint. Also confirm whether export includes attachments/embeds.
alex_kaplan: Agreed. Proposed MVP scope for product backlog:
1) API: GET/POST export with audit trail (blocker)
2) Per-tenant retention config + default presets (90d/1y/3y) (blocker)
3) BYOK: handshake + key-ref support + minimal UI for key upload (blocked by legal on escrow terms)
4) Audit logging: immutable audit events for retention changes (non-blocker but high)

samir_gupta: Implementation notes for infra:
- storage: tiered buckets (hot/cold/archive)
- TTL enforcement: run async job to redact/expire tokens, emit audit event
- export: signed-presigned URLs, retention write-protections
- KMS: support external key refs (do not store plaintext), support rotate/delete hooks

jess_ops: Testing/launch criteria (pass/fail):
- E2E: create tenant, set retention, ingest data, trigger retention expiry -> verify purge + audit event
- BYOK: handshake, simulate rotate, simulate customer-initiated revoke -> system must fall back to OTP-encrypted key escrow (if legal allows)
- Compliance: SOC2 checklist items documented and reviewed by security + legal

alex_kaplan: Risks we should call out now: cost, legal escrow timeline, key rotation complexity, customer expectations (they may expect 10y by default). Proposal: gate enterprise 10y behind signed contract + ops runbook.

maria_patel: I'll draft the Data Retention Matrix doc for legal and loop in privacy. Also will confirm export shape for attachments.

samir_gupta: I'll size infra tasks and push a spike for BYOK handshake (2d) + archive pricing (1d).

jess_ops: I'll add runbook items and test cases to the QA board. After legal greenlight, we can schedule canary rollout to a single enterprise account.

alex_kaplan: Thanks — next step: collect comments here by EOD, then I'll convert to product PRD and mark gating items as backlog-1. @maria_patel can you confirm legal ETA? :calendar:

maria_patel: Legal ETA: EOD + 2 business days for escrow template review. If they raise new redlines, that will push enterprise 10y to next sprint.

alex_kaplan: Cool. Action items summarized:
- maria_patel -> retention matrix + legal/escrow ETA
- samir_gupta -> infra spike + cost estimate
- jess_ops -> runbook + test-cases
- alex_kaplan -> PRD + backlog items

(End)
